title: Cross-validate: derived secrets match
notes:
BLOCKED (2026-08-26): RFC 9528 Appendix A.1 Table 14 requires Initiator OSCORE Sender ID=C_R and Recipient ID=C_I; Responder Sender ID=C_I and Recipient ID=C_R. Current in-repo Python export uses Initiator C_I/C_R and Responder C_R/C_I, and edhoc.json plus tests encode that inverse mapping. The patched Rust dependency at /Volumes/Attic/Desktop/Projects/crates/oscore independently has the same inverse mapping in src/edhoc/initiator.rs and responder.rs, and that external repo is dirty/outside the project-LICHEN workflow scope, so complete Python/Rust correction cannot be made safely here. Affected in-repo files requiring coordinated follow-up after the external dependency is corrected: python/src/lichen/crypto/edhoc.py; python/tests/crypto/test_edhoc.py; rust/lichen-oscore/tests/vectors.rs; test/vectors/edhoc.json; test/vectors/generate.py. Existing Rust vector test is self-consistency only: it checks IDs and Rust-to-Rust communication but does not compare exported master secret/salt to the shared Python oracle. Focused audit evidence: Python parity suite 2 passed/2 XPASS (stale xfail markers), Rust exported-context test passes the non-normative mapping. No files changed for this bead.
2026-08-27 wave check: exact protocol is EDHOC RFC 9528 exporter output into paired OSCORE contexts (master secret, master salt, and role-specific Sender/Recipient IDs). Live overlap requires release: rust/lichen-oscore/src/lib.rs and multiple Zephyr OSCORE files are dirty in project-LICHEN, while the patched Rust dependency's src/edhoc/initiator.rs and responder.rs are both actively dirty in /Volumes/Attic/Desktop/Projects/crates/oscore. No parity test was rerun because it would only prove stale self-consistency during active correction. No files modified; released immediately.
COMPLETED 2026-08-27: aligned EDHOC->OSCORE exporter parity to RFC 9528/9529 and RFC 8613 across Python, patched Rust oscore, and Zephyr C. Fixed Table-14 role mapping (Initiator Sender=C_R/Recipient=C_I; Responder inverse), RFC EDHOC_KDF info=(label, bstr(context), length), current message_2/PLAINTEXT_2 C_R placement, Method-0 hash-length MACs, Ed25519 COSE credential, transcript CBOR wrapping, and four-element COSE Sig_structure. Added independent RFC 9529 literals (PRK_4e3m, TH_4, PRK_out, PRK_exporter, master secret/salt, role IDs), a deterministic Python/Rust every-stage gate, in-repo Rust exact master-secret/salt assertions, and isolated Zephyr exporter lifecycle/atomicity tests. Evidence: Python EDHOC+OSCORE 86/86; edhoc vector freshness 1/1; ruff+mypy pass. Patched Rust oscore full tests 109/109, clippy -D warnings, no_std check; in-repo lichen-oscore shared-vector tests 14/14 plus clippy/no_std. Zephyr 4.1 qemu_x86 build passed with the documented gate-only -Wno-error=duplicated-branches workaround; runtime suite 2/2, PROJECT EXECUTION SUCCESSFUL (QEMU required bounded termination after summary). Fixture generator cmp passed. Wrong credentials, transcript tampering, malformed messages, role symmetry, exact bytes, export lifecycle, and no-mutation-on-failure are covered.
